recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle, gritty portrait of two men in western-influenced attire sitting on weathered concrete stairs. The scene is characterized by a cool blue color cast, harsh directional lighting, and a prominent, distressed slab-serif typographic block in the lower right corner.
coreVisualRelationships: The subjects are tiered vertically following the incline of the stairs.
The cool blue shadows contrast with the warm skin tones and red footwear accents.
The heavy, white typography anchors the bottom right quadrant against the dark clothing of the subjects.
The diagonal lines of the staircase create a sense of depth and perspective.
coreInvariants: Cool blue-toned color grading in the shadows and midtones.
Weathered concrete texture throughout the background.
Western-style clothing including a wide-brimmed black hat and leather jackets.
High-contrast lighting that creates deep shadows.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two male subjects occupy the central and left-of-center space, scaled to fill approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man in the foreground with the black cowboy hat and red boots acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the foreground subject's hat, moves down to the red boots, then follows the stairs up to the second subject, finally resting on the large text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the frame is tightly packed with the subjects and the architectural texture of the stairs.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated blue-grey tones in the concrete and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks in the leather jackets and hat.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red on the boots and warm flesh tones.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright white text and dark clothing; low saturation overall except for the red accents.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold slab serif with condensed proportions.
letterConstructionRules: Heavy, blocky serifs with sharp corners.
Visible distressing and 'weathered' texture within the letterforms.
Arched or warped baseline for the top line of text.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'M' and 'N' have deep, sharp crotches.
The 'G' features a prominent, square spur.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family dominance with varying warps and scales.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the rugged, industrial feel of the concrete setting.
Aligns with the country music aesthetic and heavy proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A cinematic, low-angle photo of two men in black leather jackets and western hats sitting on a set of old, blue-tinted concrete stairs. The lighting is harsh and directional. One man in the foreground wears bright red boots. The overall mood is gritty and urban.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a two-line stack of large, white, distressed slab-serif text in the bottom right corner. The top line should be slightly arched. The text should have a heavy, weathered appearance.

verificationChecks: Is the blue tint consistent across the concrete?
Are the red boots a focal point of color?
Is the typography sufficiently heavy and distressed?
Does the text overlap the subject slightly to create depth?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue color cast
Amount of distress on the typography
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
Specific artist names in the text
postGenerationChecks: Check for the presence of the blue color grade.
Ensure the typography is in a heavy slab-serif style.
Verify the low-angle perspective of the staircase.
Confirm the red boots provide a sharp color contrast.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Gritty Urban Architecture] + [Western Fashion] + [Cool Blue Color Grade] + [Distressed Heavy Slab Serif Typography] to create a modern country aesthetic.
